instruction: Convert the image to LAB color mode in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: LAB color mode conversion is not natively supported in GIMP. While GIMP supports RGB, Grayscale, and Indexed modes, LAB (CIELAB) color space operations require specialized plugins or external tools. This task is infeasible within standard GIMP.
